case_number: 2024 INSC 955; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 458 OF 2012; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 2032 OF 2017
summary: Circumstantial evidence in murder conviction; asphyxia by neck pressure; hyoid bone fracture; family property dispute; pressure on widow to relinquish share; prior complaint under CrPC 107/116; missing person report leading to body discovery; lock concealment attempt; Fardbayan recording; separate trials for co-accused; life imprisonment upheld for three convicts; acquittals of other accused; High Court confirmation challenged.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and life imprisonment upheld; High Court judgment confirmed.
